title: Boundary Oracle
claim: The review oracle must reject malformed pointers, ring links, sizes and cursor counts before any payload copy; valid baseline ring entries must remain accepted. No runtime or host test has been run for these new boundary cases yet.

evidence.observation: Binds the current source/map/Ghidra inputs before any code edit.
Plan requires state/effect, bounded-model, host harness, independent review and kernel-lab evidence; readiness is not a pass.

unknowns: The legitimate userspace publication order and concurrent payload mutation semantics are unknown.
obligations_before_completion: Cases: null cursor; cursor below head; cursor at or beyond head+0x4000; cursor in-range but unaligned; expected final-node wrap; next points outside pool; next points to wrong aligned node; data_size -1, 0, 1000, 1001; count -1, size, size+1; remaining output length 0 and one byte.
Run deterministic host boundary harness and sanitizer if source implementation is added.
KUnit/lockdep/KCSAN and hardware runtime remain pending and must be reported as such.
scope: Richtap shared FIFO used by richtap_update_fifo_data and richtap_rtp_work; offline NX809J stock evidence only.
